summary.title: What I Build
summary.description: I develop internal tools and custom applications on the NetSuite/SuiteScript platform for a mid-size distribution company. Here's a breakdown of the types of solutions I deliver.

capabilities.description: Full-stack learning management systems with interactive courses, server-side quiz grading, per-user progress tracking, and bilingual content delivery (EN/FR).
highlights: React SPA served through ERP backend
Quiz answers validated server-side — never exposed to the client
capabilities.scale: Used by all employees for onboarding and ongoing training

capabilities.description: KPI dashboards for warehouse operations and company-wide performance metrics. Multiple iterations refined through direct feedback from operations teams.
capabilities.scale: 4+ dashboards monitored daily by operations and management

capabilities.description: Monitoring and recovery tools for warehouse management system (WMS) and e-commerce platform synchronization. Built to detect failures, surface actionable errors, and enable one-click recovery.
highlights: External API session management and caching
capabilities.scale: Processes thousands of orders across multiple channels

capabilities.description: Interactive query builders, bulk data processors, and search analytics tools that give teams self-service access to ERP data without writing code.
highlights: Interactive SQL-like query builder and executor
Bulk image search and ZIP export
CSV import job monitoring and management

capabilities.description: Approval interfaces, order management tools, email builders, and document management systems that streamline daily operations.
highlights: Weekly summary email composer and distributor
capabilities.scale: Supports daily operations across multiple teams

capabilities.description: Internal tools for developers and admins — from interactive JavaScript reference tables to admin dashboards for system configuration and data imports.
highlights: Admin dashboard for CSV imports and config
Support case Kanban board with visual management
Data browser for product catalog exploration
capabilities.scale: Used by dev and admin teams
